meta.title: PTC Creator Mode
meta.description: The union the shipped presets never shipped: PTC mode (run_code as the orchestration surface) plus the Creation-mode Cordis toolset and authoring skills, declared live on the preset roster. A workflow card setting picks the Creation side (workflow tool on, default) or an exact official-ptc mirror.

en.peer.hint: With dsh-gitbash-shell installed it also registers a 「Creation Mode · Git Bash」 entry, which covers the same ground as this preset (a Git Bash build while the cooperation is active). Deduplication stops it registering that entry; the default keeps today's behaviour. This switch IS the one on dsh-gitbash-shell's settings card — both sides share a single state, so a change on either side updates both at once. Shown only while dsh-gitbash-shell is installed.
en.peer.label: Deduplicate with dsh-gitbash-shell
en.python.hint: While off (default) run_code uses the official Node/TypeScript backend, byte-identical to the shipped composition; turning it on switches to dsh's experimental CPython backend, which also moves run_code's language, generated SDK prompt and tool presentation to Python. It needs a POSIX platform with CPython ≥ 3.10 (unavailable on Windows). Takes effect after restarting dsh; dsh-gitbash-shell's card reads and writes the same state, so either side updates both.
en.python.label: run_code backend
